Cherokee History Culture and Living Nations

Owner-supplied reading-lead compilation on broader Cherokee history, women and towns, language and education, removal, slavery and Freedmen history, and living Cherokee institutions. Cherokee Nation, Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians and United Keetoowah Band are discussed as separately named governments, not interchangeable with the broader people. These 50 exact URLs and their supplied annotations are contributed leads, not 50 independently verified sources or full-book reviews. Publisher descriptions, indexes, archival introductions, edited excerpts and abstracts remain distinct from inspected original content. Source-specific dates, current legal or citizenship claims, quantitative estimates and media rights require separate review. The private full attachment is not reproduced.
